Technical SEO.title: Google Search Console AI Performance Report and AI Control Now Live Globally
Technical SEO.summary: Google has released Search Console generative AI performance reports and Search generative AI controls to all users globally, completing a rollout that began in early June. Enterprise SEOs can now measure AI search performance and adjust AI controls directly in Search Console.

Technical SEO.title: September 2026 Google Webmaster Report
Technical SEO.summary: The monthly Google webmaster report recaps the largest stories from August related to Google SEO, search, and site owner topics. A useful consolidated reference for tracking algorithm and policy changes over the past month.

Technical SEO.title: Google Search Verifying Your Request To Continue To Search Results
Technical SEO.summary: Google is testing a verification step where searchers must click a Continue button after a brief wait before seeing results, following an earlier test that required sign-in. This has potential implications for crawl and indexation monitoring, as bot-filtering mechanisms at the search layer may affect how traffic patterns are interpreted.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Schema For AI Citations: How To Become A Trusted Source
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Loren Baker explains how consistent structured data builds entity trust across local, ecommerce, and author-driven content, positioning schema as a foundational signal for AI citation rather than a direct ranking switch. Directly actionable for enterprise sites seeking visibility in AI answer surfaces.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: How We Earned 1,000+ Links For GEO and SEO
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Kevin Rowe breaks down a digital PR system that generated over 1,000 earned citations, covering which data stories attract journalist coverage and how research-driven content secures AI Overviews placements. The intersection of link-building and GEO makes this directly relevant for enterprise content strategy.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Details Who Can License Its Search Data In Europe
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google has published eligibility rules, data samples, and key dates for licensing ranking, query, click, and view data from EEA Search under the EU Digital Markets Act. Enterprise SEOs operating in European markets should review eligibility and timeline implications for competitive data access.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: WordPress Announces A Proactive Security Initiative
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: WordPress announced a new security initiative aimed at scaling protections as AI tooling makes it easier for bad actors to discover and exploit vulnerabilities. Enterprise sites running WordPress CMS should assess exposure given the expanded threat surface described.

AI Search / GEO.title: Demystifying Grounding Queries with Real Data
AI Search / GEO.summary: The post explains how Google Gemini uses grounding queries to source real-time facts and advises optimizing content for machine search rather than targeting zero-volume keywords. This is directly actionable for GEO practitioners building content strategies for AI answer surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: The Technical Signals AI Search Uses That Most SEOs Still Are Not Optimizing
AI Search / GEO.summary: An audit of 50 major websites identifies the technical signals that AI search engines use for citations, highlighting gaps that most SEO teams have yet to address. The findings are directly applicable to enterprise AI readiness assessments.

AI Search / GEO.title: Inside ChatGPT Search: how web.run and fan-out queries shape AI visibility
AI Search / GEO.summary: The piece examines how ChatGPT Search uses the web.run tool and fan-out query patterns to retrieve and surface content, with implications for how brands can structure pages to improve AI search visibility. Understanding this crawl and retrieval mechanic is foundational for GEO strategy.

AI Search / GEO.title: Generative Engine Optimization: How to Dominate AI Search
AI Search / GEO.summary: An arXiv paper on generative engine optimization strategies for improving visibility in AI-driven search systems. Academic sourcing provides a higher-credibility foundation for GEO frameworks compared to agency blog posts on the same topic.

AI Search / GEO.title: GEO Governance: Concentration, Disclosure, and Academic Blind Spots
AI Search / GEO.summary: This arXiv position paper argues that generative engine optimization creates underexamined risks and calls for governance targeting source concentration, disclosure requirements, and gaps in academic research. Relevant for enterprise teams building GEO programs with compliance or brand-safety considerations.

AI Search / GEO.title: A Docs Page Is a Long and Complex Search Query to Find AI Agents
AI Search / GEO.summary: The post reframes documentation pages as the equivalent of detailed search queries that AI agents use to discover and evaluate tools and services. This perspective on answer engine optimization is actionable for enterprise teams structuring product and help content for AI retrieval.
